posts.author: DaffyMimi
posts.body: Hi, I'm trying to make a turn-based combat style game, like Deltarune as an example and I made my own sideview animations but I am having a hard time importing them into rpg maker mz. I turned them into a sprite sheet and I want to see if I can attach these aniamtions to a certain skill for the player to use in battle and that will play the animations I worked weeks on. I also want to change the side view of the players from the right to the left. Any plugins or ideas I should look for? thank you!

posts.author: Canned_Dinosaur
posts.body:
Hello there! I think this is your first time posting, so please
follow these guidelines
(screenshots are very helpful!)
Also, I suspect that you are wanting to use sprite sheet animation in MZ. In order to do that you need to right click an animation record and select "Create MV-compatible data". From there you can just follow any instructions for MV animations.
